blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.en: Understand the role and structure of the User Requirement Specification (URS) in an SUS facility project

blocks.zh: 掌握 URS 範例中涵蓋的主要領域：設施描述、製程、物料流、人員流、法規、公用設施、潔淨室、控制系統
blocks.en: Grasp the main areas covered by the URS example: facility description, process, material flow, personnel flow, regulatory requirements, utilities, cleanrooms and control systems

blocks.zh: 學習如何為基因治療病毒載體的 SUS 生產設施撰寫使用者需求
blocks.en: Learn how to write user requirements for an SUS manufacturing facility for gene therapy viral vectors

blocks.zh: 認識 BSL2 生物安全要求如何影響設施設計與 HVAC 系統規劃
blocks.en: Recognize how BSL2 biosafety requirements affect facility design and HVAC system planning

blocks.zh: 了解 URS 如何為後續設計確認 (DQ) 及驗證活動奠定基礎
blocks.en: Understand how the URS lays the foundation for Design Qualification (DQ) and subsequent qualification/validation activities

blocks.zh: 8.0 / 8.1 Description of Document 8.0 / 8.1 文件說明
blocks.en: 8.0 / 8.1 Description of Document

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: User Requirement Specification, URS (使用者需求規格書): URS 是製藥工程專案中最重要的基礎文件之一。它由使用者（製藥公司）撰寫，明確定義「我需要什麼」，而非「如何做到」。URS 是後續所有設計（概念設計、基本設計、細節設計）的起點，也是 Design Qualification (DQ) 的驗證依據。
blocks.en: User Requirement Specification, URS: The URS is one of the most important foundation documents in a pharmaceutical engineering project. It is written by the user (the pharmaceutical company) and defines clearly "what I need", not "how to achieve it". The URS is the starting point for all subsequent design (concept design, basic design, detailed design) and is the basis for Design Qualification (DQ).

blocks.zh: Living Document (活文件): URS 不是一次定稿就永不更改的文件。隨著專案進展、法規變化或製程需求調整，URS 可以且應該被更新——但必須透過正式的變更管控 (Change Control) 程序。
blocks.en: Living Document: A URS is not a document that is finalized once and never changed. As the project progresses, regulations change or process needs are adjusted, the URS can and should be updated, but only through a formal Change Control procedure.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: URS 就像蓋房子時的「需求清單」：你告訴建築師「我需要三間臥室、兩間浴室、一個開放式廚房」，但不會告訴他用什麼品牌的水泥或什麼尺寸的鋼筋。URS 描述的是「What」（需要什麼），而非「How」（如何實現）。建築師根據你的需求出設計圖，就像工程公司根據 URS 產出設計規格 (Design Specification)。
blocks.en: A URS is like the "requirements list" when building a house: you tell the architect "I need three bedrooms, two bathrooms and an open kitchen", but you do not tell them which brand of cement or what size of rebar to use. The URS describes the "What" (what is needed), not the "How" (how it is achieved). The architect produces drawings based on your requirements, just as the engineering company produces a Design Specification based on the URS.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本附錄提供的是一個整體性 (Overall) 的 URS 範例，實際專案中還需要針對個別系統（如 HVAC 系統、WFI 系統、自動化系統等）撰寫更詳細的 URS。整體 URS 定義大框架，細節 URS 則深入每個子系統。
blocks.en: This appendix provides an overall URS example. In actual projects, more detailed URSs are also needed for individual systems (such as the HVAC system, WFI system, automation system, etc.). The overall URS defines the big framework, while the detailed URSs go deep into each subsystem.

blocks.zh: 注意：本 URS 範例中的需求「may not be qualified」——意思是這些需求不一定全部需要正式確認 (Qualification)，但它們構成設計的基礎。哪些需求需要確認，會在後續風險評估中決定。
blocks.en: Note: the requirements in this URS example "may not be qualified". This means that not every requirement necessarily needs formal qualification, but they form the basis of the design. Which requirements need qualification is decided in the subsequent risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 URS 被稱為「活文件」？在什麼情況下需要更新 URS？
blocks.en: Why is the URS called a "living document"? In what situations does the URS need to be updated?

blocks.zh: URS 可以由「end user 的 sponsor（如工程公司或供應商）」撰寫，這在 CDMO 情境中意味著什麼？
blocks.en: A URS can be written by "the end user's sponsor (such as an engineering company or supplier)". What does this mean in a CDMO context?

blocks.zh: 「Overall URS」與「Detailed URS」之間有何差異？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: What is the difference between an "Overall URS" and a "Detailed URS"? Please give an example.

blocks.zh: 8.2 Introduction 8.2 導論
blocks.en: 8.2 Introduction

blocks.zh: 8.2.1 Description of Facility 8.2.1 廠房說明
blocks.en: 8.2.1 Description of Facility

blocks.zh: BSL2 (生物安全等級 2): BSL2 適用於處理對人員有中等潛在危害的微生物。此案例使用活病毒載體（腺病毒），因此需要 BSL2 等級的生物安全防護。這直接影響設施的 HVAC 設計（需要負壓或定向氣流）、廢棄物處理（需要滅活）、及人員防護。
blocks.en: BSL2 (Biosafety Level 2): BSL2 applies to work with microorganisms that pose a moderate potential hazard to personnel. This case uses a live viral vector (adenovirus), so BSL2-level biosafety containment is required. This directly affects the facility HVAC design (negative pressure or directional airflow is needed), waste handling (inactivation is needed) and personnel protection.

blocks.zh: Gene Therapy (基因治療): 利用病毒載體將治療性基因送入患者細胞。此處使用腺病毒 (Adenovirus) 作為載體，是一種常見的基因治療技術平台。
blocks.en: Gene Therapy: Uses viral vectors to deliver therapeutic genes into a patient's cells. Adenovirus is used here as the vector, which is a common gene therapy technology platform.

blocks.zh: 雙重法規合規: 設施需同時符合 EU GMP 和 FDA cGMP，這表明產品將在歐盟和美國市場上市。雙重合規會增加設計複雜度，因為兩套法規在潔淨室分級、環境監控等方面有些許差異。
blocks.en: Dual regulatory compliance: The facility must comply with both EU GMP and FDA cGMP, indicating that the product will be marketed in the EU and the US. Dual compliance increases design complexity, because the two sets of regulations differ slightly in cleanroom classification, environmental monitoring and other areas.

blocks.zh: BSL2 設施就像一個「有門禁的實驗室」——與一般辦公室相比，它有嚴格的出入管控、特殊的通風系統（確保空氣只往內流，不往外洩）、以及專用的廢棄物處理通道。想像一個處理感染性物質的醫院病房：空氣是負壓控制的，廢棄物要先滅菌才能丟棄，人員進出要換裝。SUS 設施在此基礎上，再加上 GMP 的潔淨度要求。
blocks.en: A BSL2 facility is like a "laboratory with access control": compared with an ordinary office, it has strict entry and exit control, a special ventilation system (ensuring air flows only inward and does not leak outward) and a dedicated waste-handling route. Imagine a hospital ward handling infectious material: the air is under negative pressure control, waste must be sterilized before disposal, and personnel must change clothing when entering and leaving. An SUS facility adds the GMP cleanliness requirements on top of this.

blocks.zh: 這個 URS 範例特別有價值，因為它展示了 SUS 技術在基因治療這類先進治療藥品 (ATMP) 生產中的應用。由於基因治療產品批量通常較小、產品種類變化快，SUS 的靈活性和免清洗特性特別適合此類應用。
blocks.en: This URS example is particularly valuable because it shows the application of SUS technology in the manufacture of gene therapy products, an advanced therapy medicinal product (ATMP) category. Because gene therapy batch sizes are usually small and product types change quickly, the flexibility and cleaning-free nature of SUS are especially well suited to such applications.

blocks.zh: 注意 URS 中使用的語言：「shall」表示強制性需求；「should」表示建議性需求。在 URS 撰寫中，用詞的選擇直接影響後續驗證的範圍。
blocks.en: Pay attention to the language used in the URS: "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement; "should" indicates a recommended requirement. In URS writing, the choice of wording directly affects the scope of subsequent qualification/validation.

blocks.zh: 8.2.2 Environment / 8.2.3 Capacity 8.2.2 環境 / 8.2.3 產能
blocks.en: 8.2.2 Environment / 8.2.3 Capacity

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計基準 (Design Basis): HVAC 系統的設計需考慮當地最極端的氣候條件。此案例設定夏季最高 +30°C/50% RH、冬季最低 −37°C，暗示設施可能位於北歐（如芬蘭）。這些數據決定了 HVAC 系統的冷卻和加熱能力設計。
blocks.en: HVAC Design Basis: The HVAC system design must consider the most extreme local climate conditions. This case sets a summer maximum of +30°C/50% RH and a winter minimum of −37°C, suggesting that the facility may be located in Northern Europe (such as Finland). These figures determine the cooling and heating capacity design of the HVAC system.

blocks.zh: 產能規劃: 年產約 130,000 瓶——在基因治療領域屬於中等規模。藥物原料 (Drug Substance) 製造需要 24/7 監控（因為細胞培養不能中斷），但充填 (Filling) 只需 8 小時/天、5 天/週，反映了兩個工段不同的運營節奏。
blocks.en: Capacity planning: An annual output of about 130,000 vials is medium scale in the gene therapy field. Drug Substance manufacturing requires 24/7 monitoring (because cell culture cannot be interrupted), but filling needs only 8 hours/day, 5 days/week, reflecting the different operating rhythms of the two process stages.

blocks.zh: 在 URS 中明確定義環境設計基準至關重要——如果 HVAC 設計基準設定錯誤（例如低估了夏季最高溫度），可能導致潔淨室在極端天氣下無法維持所需的溫濕度條件，進而影響產品品質和 GMP 合規性。
blocks.en: It is essential to define the environmental design basis clearly in the URS. If the HVAC design basis is set incorrectly (for example, the summer maximum temperature is underestimated), the cleanroom may be unable to maintain the required temperature and humidity conditions in extreme weather, affecting product quality and GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 8.2.4 Process 8.2.4 製程
blocks.en: 8.2.4 Process

blocks.zh: 製程流程概觀: 這是一個典型的腺病毒載體生產製程，包含以下關鍵階段：
blocks.en: Process flow overview: This is a typical adenovirus vector production process, comprising the following key stages:

blocks.zh: 上游 (Upstream): 細胞解凍 → 細胞擴增 → 病毒感染 → 細胞裂解
blocks.en: Upstream: cell thaw → cell expansion → viral infection → cell lysis

blocks.zh: 下游 (Downstream): 深層過濾 → 超過濾/透析過濾 → 層析純化 → 濃縮/換液
blocks.en: Downstream: depth filtration → ultrafiltration/diafiltration → chromatography purification → concentration/buffer exchange

blocks.zh: 充填 (Fill & Finish): 無菌過濾 → 充填 → 加塞 → 壓蓋
blocks.en: Fill & Finish: sterile filtration → filling → stoppering → capping

blocks.zh: 注意所有上游和下游步驟都標註為「API clean process」（原料藥潔淨製程），而充填則標註為「aseptic process」（無菌製程），反映不同工段的無菌要求等級。
blocks.en: Note that all upstream and downstream steps are labeled "API clean process", while filling is labeled "aseptic process", reflecting the different sterility requirement levels of the different stages.

blocks.zh: SUS 在這個製程中的角色就像「免洗餐具」用於外燴活動——每次使用全新的拋棄式設備（搖擺袋、管路、過濾器、層析管柱等），用完即丟，不需要清洗和滅菌。這不僅省去了 CIP/SIP 系統的建置成本，更重要的是消除了交叉污染的風險——就像用免洗餐具永遠不會有前一位客人的殘留。
blocks.en: The role of SUS in this process is like "disposable tableware" at a catered event: every use involves brand-new single-use equipment (rocker bags, tubing, filters, chromatography columns, etc.) that is discarded after use, with no need for cleaning and sterilization. This not only saves the cost of building CIP/SIP systems but, more importantly, eliminates the risk of cross-contamination, just as disposable tableware never carries residue from the previous guest.

blocks.zh: SUS 對設施設計的簡化效果:
blocks.en: How SUS simplifies facility design:

blocks.zh: 無需 CIP 站 — 大幅減少公用設施需求和設備佔地面積
blocks.en: No CIP station needed - greatly reduces utility demand and equipment footprint

blocks.zh: 無需 SIP 系統 — 不需要潔淨蒸氣系統的複雜管線配置
blocks.en: No SIP system needed - no need for the complex piping layout of a clean steam system

blocks.zh: 但仍需高壓滅菌釜 (Autoclave) — 用於可重複使用設備的滅菌和 BSL2 廢棄物的滅活
blocks.en: But an autoclave is still needed - for sterilizing reusable equipment and inactivating BSL2 waste

blocks.zh: 這是 SUS 的核心價值主張：簡化設施、加速建設、降低資本支出，但不是完全消除所有傳統設備。
blocks.en: This is the core value proposition of SUS: simplify the facility, speed up construction and reduce capital expenditure, but not eliminate all traditional equipment entirely.

blocks.zh: 生物安全滅活要求 Biosafety Inactivation
blocks.en: Biosafety Inactivation

blocks.zh: 由於使用活病毒載體 (BSL2)，所有接觸過製程物料的廢水和排放物必須經過化學或熱滅活才能排入公共下水道。這是生物安全法規的硬性要求，在 URS 中必須明確定義滅活系統的規格。
blocks.en: Because live viral vectors (BSL2) are used, all effluent and discharges that have contacted process materials must undergo chemical or thermal inactivation before being discharged to the public sewer. This is a hard requirement of biosafety regulations, and the specification of the inactivation system must be clearly defined in the URS.

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使採用全拋棄式設備，仍然需要高壓滅菌釜？
blocks.en: Why is an autoclave still needed even when fully disposable equipment is used?

blocks.zh: 如果把此設施從 BSL2 降為 BSL1，URS 中哪些需求可以簡化或省略？
blocks.en: If this facility were downgraded from BSL2 to BSL1, which requirements in the URS could be simplified or omitted?

blocks.zh: 「API clean process」與「aseptic process」在潔淨室等級要求上有何差異？
blocks.en: What is the difference between an "API clean process" and an "aseptic process" in terms of cleanroom grade requirements?

blocks.zh: 8.2.5 Material Flows 8.2.5 物料流
blocks.en: 8.2.5 Material Flows

blocks.zh: Unidirectional Flow (單向流動): 物料和人員只能沿一個方向移動，避免乾淨物料與廢棄物料交叉。這是 GMP 設施設計的基本原則之一，也是防止交叉污染 (Cross-Contamination) 的關鍵。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Flow: Materials and personnel may move in one direction only, avoiding crossover between clean materials and waste materials. This is one of the basic principles of GMP facility design and is key to preventing cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: Line Clearance (生產線清場): 在不同產品批次之間進行的清潔和檢查程序，確保上一批次的物料不會殘留在生產線上。在 SUS 設施中，由於使用拋棄式設備，line clearance 的範圍和複雜度會大幅降低。
blocks.en: Line Clearance: The cleaning and inspection procedure carried out between different product batches to ensure that materials from the previous batch do not remain on the line. In an SUS facility, because disposable equipment is used, the scope and complexity of line clearance are greatly reduced.

blocks.zh: Material Airlock (物料氣鎖): 連接不同潔淨等級區域的過渡空間，用於物料傳遞。氣鎖內維持壓差，防止低潔淨區的空氣進入高潔淨區。
blocks.en: Material Airlock: A transition space connecting areas of different cleanliness grades, used for material transfer. A pressure differential is maintained in the airlock to prevent air from the lower-grade area from entering the higher-grade area.

blocks.zh: 物料流管理就像機場的行李處理系統——出境行李和入境行李走不同的通道，不會交叉。「Airlock」就像機場的安檢區——所有進入管制區的物品必須經過檢查和處理（拆包、噴酒精消毒或 VHP 滅菌），才能進入更乾淨的區域。
blocks.en: Material flow management is like an airport baggage handling system: outbound and inbound luggage use different routes and never cross. An "airlock" is like the airport security checkpoint: everything entering the controlled area must be inspected and processed (unpacking, alcohol spraying or VHP sterilization) before entering a cleaner area.

blocks.zh: 儲存需求設計: URS 要求原物料儲存量為至少兩個月的生產需求，成品儲存為六個月的產量。成品儲存需求較大，因為基因治療產品需要在 −70°C 冷凍儲存，且放行檢測需要較長時間。這些數字直接決定了冷凍櫃和液態氮儲存設施的規模。
blocks.en: Storage requirement design: The URS requires raw material storage of at least two months of production demand and finished product storage of six months of output. The finished product storage requirement is larger because gene therapy products must be stored frozen at −70°C and release testing takes longer. These figures directly determine the size of the freezer and liquid nitrogen storage facilities.

blocks.zh: SUS 對儲存的特殊影響: 使用拋棄式設備意味著需要大量儲存空間來存放一次性耗材（袋子、管路、過濾器等），這是傳統不鏽鋼設施不需要考慮的。
blocks.en: Special impact of SUS on storage: Using disposable equipment means that a large amount of storage space is needed for single-use consumables (bags, tubing, filters, etc.), which a traditional stainless steel facility does not need to consider.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 URS 要求物料氣鎖必須是「one-way type」？如果允許雙向通行會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does the URS require the material airlock to be a "one-way type"? What risks would arise if two-way passage were allowed?

blocks.zh: 進入 C 級區域的物料需要「噴灑酒精」，而進入 B 級區域的充填組件需要「清洗除熱源」或「VHP 循環」——為什麼要求不同？
blocks.en: Materials entering the grade C area need "alcohol spraying", while filling components entering the grade B area need "washing and depyrogenation" or a "VHP cycle". Why are the requirements different?

blocks.zh: 8.2.6 Personnel Flows / 8.2.7 Training 8.2.6 人員流動 / 8.2.7 教育訓練
blocks.en: 8.2.6 Personnel Flows / 8.2.7 Training

blocks.zh: Personnel Airlock 的雙重目的:
blocks.en: The dual purpose of the personnel airlock:

blocks.zh: GMP 目的: 維持潔淨區的正壓差，防止外界空氣中的微粒和微生物進入
blocks.en: GMP purpose: maintain positive pressure differential in the clean area and prevent particles and microorganisms in outside air from entering

blocks.zh: BSL2 目的: 防止活性區 (Active Areas，即處理活病毒的區域) 的生物性污染物擴散到非活性區
blocks.en: BSL2 purpose: prevent biological contaminants from Active Areas (areas where live virus is handled) from spreading to non-active areas

blocks.zh: 這兩個目的有時會產生衝突——GMP 要求潔淨區正壓（空氣從乾淨區往髒區流），而 BSL2 要求活性區負壓（空氣從外往內流，防止生物危害物外洩）。設施設計必須巧妙平衡這兩個需求。
blocks.en: These two purposes sometimes conflict: GMP requires positive pressure in the clean area (air flows from the clean area to the dirty area), while BSL2 requires negative pressure in the active area (air flows from outside inward, preventing the release of biohazards). The facility design must balance these two requirements skillfully.

blocks.zh: 人員氣鎖就像「太空站的氣密艙」——太空人從外太空（非管控區）進入太空站（潔淨區）前，必須在氣密艙中換裝、加壓。同樣，操作人員從辦公區進入潔淨室前，必須在更衣區逐層穿上無塵衣。差別在於，這裡還要考慮 BSL2 的反向需求——有些區域的空氣流向要「向內」而非「向外」。
blocks.en: A personnel airlock is like the "airlock chamber of a space station": before astronauts enter the station (clean area) from outer space (uncontrolled area), they must change clothing and pressurize in the airlock. Similarly, before entering the cleanroom from the office area, operators must put on cleanroom garments layer by layer in the gowning area. The difference is that the opposite BSL2 requirement must also be considered here: in some areas the air must flow "inward" rather than "outward".

blocks.zh: 緊急出口與生物安全的平衡: URS 中特別提到「emergency exits should not compromise contained operation」——這意味著即使在緊急疏散時，也要盡可能維持生物安全的圍阻。這在實務設計中是一個挑戰，需要特殊的氣鎖設計或連鎖控制系統。
blocks.en: Balancing emergency exits and biosafety: The URS specifically mentions "emergency exits should not compromise contained operation", meaning that biosafety containment should be maintained as far as possible even during emergency evacuation. This is a challenge in practical design and requires special airlock designs or interlock control systems.

blocks.zh: 人力規劃: 僅需 8-11 人即可運行整個設施，反映了 SUS 設施的人力效率優勢——不需要大量人力進行設備清洗、組裝和滅菌驗證等工作。
blocks.en: Manpower planning: Only 8-11 people are needed to run the whole facility, reflecting the manpower efficiency advantage of SUS facilities: a large workforce is not needed for equipment cleaning, assembly, sterilization validation and similar work.

blocks.zh: GMP 正壓需求和 BSL2 負壓需求如何在同一設施中共存？請思考可能的設計方案。
blocks.en: How can the GMP positive pressure requirement and the BSL2 negative pressure requirement coexist in the same facility? Consider possible design solutions.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 URS 要求「工作區域應該讓檢查員和 QA 人員可以觀察」？這對設施設計有何影響？
blocks.en: Why does the URS require that "work areas should allow inspectors and QA personnel to observe"? How does this affect facility design?

blocks.zh: 8.3 Regulatory Requirements 8.3 法規要求
blocks.en: 8.3 Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: 多重法規合規框架:
blocks.en: Multiple regulatory compliance framework:

blocks.zh: US CFR: 美國聯邦法規，特別是 21 CFR Part 211 (藥品 cGMP) 和 Part 600 (生物製品)
blocks.en: US CFR: US federal regulations, in particular 21 CFR Part 211 (cGMP for drug products) and Part 600 (biological products)

blocks.zh: EU GMP: 歐盟 GMP 指南，包括 Annex 1 (無菌藥品製造)
blocks.en: EU GMP: EU GMP Guidelines, including Annex 1 (manufacture of sterile medicinal products)

blocks.zh: PIC/S: 藥品稽查合作計畫，提供全球一致的 GMP 稽查標準
blocks.en: PIC/S: Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme, providing globally consistent GMP inspection standards

blocks.zh: Finnish Legislation: 確認設施位於芬蘭，需遵守當地法規
blocks.en: Finnish Legislation: confirms that the facility is located in Finland and must comply with local regulations

blocks.zh: 關鍵標準:
blocks.en: Key standards:

blocks.zh: ISO 14644: 潔淨室和相關控制環境的分級與測試標準
blocks.en: ISO 14644: standard for classification and testing of cleanrooms and associated controlled environments

blocks.zh: ISO 14698: 潔淨室的生物污染控制標準
blocks.en: ISO 14698: standard for biocontamination control in cleanrooms

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-1: 壓縮空氣品質標準
blocks.en: ISO 8573-1: compressed air quality standard

blocks.zh: GAMP: 良好自動化製造實務，用於電腦化系統驗證
blocks.en: GAMP: Good Automated Manufacturing Practice, used for computerized system validation

blocks.zh: 在 URS 中列出所有適用的法規和標準非常重要——這些構成了設計的法規邊界條件。如果遺漏了某個適用法規，可能導致設施建成後無法通過監管機構的查廠檢查 (Regulatory Inspection)。
blocks.en: It is very important to list all applicable regulations and standards in the URS: they form the regulatory boundary conditions of the design. If an applicable regulation is omitted, the facility may be unable to pass regulatory inspection after it is built.

blocks.zh: CE 標誌 (CE Mark) 的要求確認設備須符合歐盟安全指令，是在歐盟境內使用設備的法律要求。
blocks.en: The CE mark requirement confirms that equipment must comply with EU safety directives, which is a legal requirement for using equipment within the EU.

blocks.zh: 如果此設施的產品也要銷往日本市場，URS 的法規需求章節需要增加哪些內容？
blocks.en: If this facility's product were also to be sold in the Japanese market, what would need to be added to the regulatory requirements section of the URS?

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 和 EU GMP 在潔淨室分級上有何差異？為什麼 URS 中要同時引用兩者？
blocks.en: What are the differences between ISO 14644 and EU GMP in cleanroom classification? Why does the URS cite both?

blocks.zh: 8.4 User Requirements 8.4 使用者需求
blocks.en: 8.4 User Requirements

blocks.zh: 8.4.1 Functional Area Requirements 8.4.1 功能區域需求
blocks.en: 8.4.1 Functional Area Requirements

blocks.zh: 功能區域清單 (Functional Area List): 這是 URS 的核心內容之一——列出設施中必須包含的所有功能區域。這份清單直接驅動設施的平面佈局 (Layout) 設計。
blocks.en: Functional Area List: This is one of the core contents of the URS: it lists all functional areas that the facility must include. This list directly drives the facility layout design.

blocks.zh: 值得注意的幾個特殊區域：
blocks.en: Several special areas worth noting:

blocks.zh: #12 vs #13: 細胞培養分為「clean」和「infected」兩個房間——這是 BSL2 和病毒生產的特殊需求，感染前和感染後的操作必須在不同房間進行
blocks.en: #12 vs #13: Cell culture is divided into "clean" and "infected" rooms. This is a special requirement of BSL2 and virus production: pre-infection and post-infection operations must be carried out in different rooms

blocks.zh: #19 Decontamination: BSL2 設施必備，用於活病毒廢棄物的滅活處理
blocks.en: #19 Decontamination: Essential in a BSL2 facility, used for inactivation of live virus waste

blocks.zh: #25 Waste Inactivation: 與 #19 配合，處理液態生物性廢棄物
blocks.en: #25 Waste Inactivation: Works together with #19 to handle liquid biological waste

blocks.zh: #30 Control Room (CNC): 控制室設在更衣流程之外，操作人員不需穿潔淨衣即可監控生產
blocks.en: #30 Control Room (CNC): The control room is located outside the gowning flow, so operators can monitor production without wearing cleanroom garments

blocks.zh: 此清單共列出30 個功能區域，足見即使是採用 SUS 的設施，空間規劃仍然相當複雜。SUS 雖然省去了 CIP/SIP 設備房，但增加了拋棄式耗材的儲存空間和廢棄物處理區域。
blocks.en: The list contains 30 functional areas, showing that even for a facility using SUS, space planning remains quite complex. Although SUS eliminates CIP/SIP equipment rooms, it adds storage space for disposable consumables and waste handling areas.

blocks.zh: 注意 #6「Weighing room (optional)」——在 SUS 設施中，許多溶液由供應商預先配製好直接以袋裝供應，因此秤量室可能不是必需的。
blocks.en: Note #6 "Weighing room (optional)": in an SUS facility, many solutions are prepared in advance by suppliers and supplied directly in bags, so a weighing room may not be necessary.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 情境中，如果要在同一設施中生產多個客戶的基因治療產品，功能區域清單需要額外考慮：專用 vs 共用區域的劃分、不同客戶產品的儲存隔離、以及更靈活的 changeover 策略。SUS 的優勢在此更加明顯——換產品時只需更換一次性耗材，而非清洗整套不鏽鋼系統。
blocks.en: In a CDMO context, if gene therapy products for several clients are to be manufactured in the same facility, the functional area list needs to consider additionally: the split between dedicated and shared areas, storage segregation of different clients' products, and a more flexible changeover strategy. The advantage of SUS is even more obvious here: changing products requires only replacing the single-use consumables, not cleaning an entire stainless steel system.

blocks.zh: 8.4.2 Utilities and Services 8.4.2 公用設施與服務
blocks.en: 8.4.2 Utilities and Services

blocks.zh: 公用設施分類:
blocks.en: Utility categories:

blocks.zh: 製程氣體: CO2、O2、製程空氣——用於搖擺袋 (Rocker) 細胞培養系統
blocks.en: Process gases: CO2, O2, process air, used for the rocker bag cell culture system

blocks.zh: 水系統: WFI（注射用水）、純水 (PW)、自來水、冷凍水——各有不同用途和品質等級
blocks.en: Water systems: WFI (water for injection), purified water (PW), tap water, chilled water, each with different uses and quality grades

blocks.zh: 蒸氣: 工廠蒸氣（加熱用）和潔淨蒸氣（滅菌用）——SUS 設施仍需潔淨蒸氣用於高壓滅菌釜
blocks.en: Steam: plant steam (for heating) and clean steam (for sterilization). An SUS facility still needs clean steam for the autoclave

blocks.zh: 廢水: 分為「活性廢水」(Waste active) 和「非活性廢水」(Waste inactive)——BSL2 設施的關鍵區分
blocks.en: Waste water: divided into "Waste active" and "Waste inactive", a key distinction in a BSL2 facility

blocks.zh: SUS 並未完全消除公用設施需求: 從表中可以看到，雖然省去了 CIP 系統，但仍需要 WFI（清洗用）、潔淨蒸氣（高壓滅菌釜用）、液態氮（冷凍儲存用）等。這提醒我們：SUS 簡化了製程接觸面的清潔和滅菌，但設施的基礎公用設施仍然是必需的。
blocks.en: SUS does not eliminate utility requirements entirely: The table shows that although the CIP system is eliminated, WFI (for cleaning), clean steam (for the autoclave), liquid nitrogen (for frozen storage) and others are still needed. This is a reminder that SUS simplifies the cleaning and sterilization of process-contact surfaces, but the facility's basic utilities are still required.

blocks.zh: VHP「Has to be considered」: 氣化過氧化氫 (VHP) 用於表面除污和氣鎖消毒，此處標註為「需考慮」而非確定需要，表示在後續詳細設計階段才會決定是否採用。
blocks.en: VHP "Has to be considered": Vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP) is used for surface decontamination and airlock disinfection. It is marked here as "to be considered" rather than definitely needed, meaning that whether to adopt it will be decided at the later detailed design stage.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 設施仍需要潔淨蒸氣 (Clean Steam)？它用在哪些地方？
blocks.en: Why does an SUS facility still need clean steam? Where is it used?

blocks.zh: 「Waste active」和「Waste inactive」的分流管理為什麼重要？如果混合處理會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why is the segregated handling of "Waste active" and "Waste inactive" important? What would be the consequences of mixing them?

blocks.zh: 8.4.3 Cleanroom and HVAC 8.4.3 潔淨室與 HVAC
blocks.en: 8.4.3 Cleanroom and HVAC

blocks.zh: ISO vs EU GMP 潔淨室分級對照:
blocks.en: ISO vs EU GMP cleanroom classification comparison:

blocks.zh: ISO 5 / Grade A: 無菌操作核心區（UDAF 層流罩下），微粒數最嚴格
blocks.en: ISO 5 / Grade A: core zone of aseptic operations (under a UDAF unidirectional airflow hood), with the strictest particle limits

blocks.zh: ISO 7 / Grade B: 無菌操作背景環境
blocks.en: ISO 7 / Grade B: background environment for aseptic operations

blocks.zh: ISO 8 / Grade C: 無菌製造的一般操作區
blocks.en: ISO 8 / Grade C: general operating area for aseptic manufacturing

blocks.zh: ISO 8 at rest / Grade D: 較低風險操作區（靜態時達到 ISO 8）
blocks.en: ISO 8 at rest / Grade D: lower-risk operating area (ISO 8 achieved at rest)

blocks.zh: Full Fresh Air System (全新風系統): 所有送入潔淨室的空氣都是經過過濾的新鮮空氣，不回收再利用。這是 BSL2 設施的要求——如果回收空氣，可能將活病毒從一個房間帶到另一個房間，造成交叉污染。
blocks.en: Full Fresh Air System: All air supplied to the cleanroom is filtered fresh air and is not recirculated. This is a BSL2 facility requirement: if air were recirculated, live virus could be carried from one room to another, causing cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: H14 排氣過濾: 處理活病毒區域的排氣必須經過 HEPA H14 過濾（效率 ≥ 99.995%），防止活病毒顆粒排入大氣。
blocks.en: H14 exhaust filtration: Exhaust from areas where live virus is handled must pass through HEPA H14 filtration (efficiency ≥ 99.995%) to prevent live virus particles from being released to the atmosphere.

blocks.zh: HVAC 的「全新風系統」就像醫院負壓隔離病房的通風——每一口送進去的空氣都是新鮮的，每一口排出來的空氣都經過 HEPA 過濾。不像一般辦公室的空調會回收室內空氣。這確保了「進去的空氣是乾淨的，出來的空氣也是安全的」。
blocks.en: A "full fresh air system" for HVAC is like the ventilation of a hospital negative pressure isolation ward: every breath of air supplied is fresh, and every breath of air exhausted has passed through HEPA filtration. Unlike ordinary office air conditioning, it does not recirculate indoor air. This ensures that "the air going in is clean and the air coming out is safe".

blocks.zh: 夜間降低風量: URS 允許在非操作時段降低送風量——這是一個重要的節能設計考量。全新風系統的能耗極高（因為所有空氣都需要加熱/冷卻和過濾），夜間降低風量可以顯著降低運營成本。但必須確保降低風量後仍能維持必要的壓差和潔淨度（at rest 狀態）。
blocks.en: Night-time air volume reduction: The URS allows the supply air volume to be reduced during non-operating periods, which is an important energy-saving design consideration. A full fresh air system consumes a great deal of energy (because all the air must be heated/cooled and filtered), and reducing air volume at night can significantly lower operating costs. However, it must be ensured that the necessary pressure differentials and cleanliness (at-rest state) can still be maintained after the reduction.

blocks.zh: 風機冗餘 (Redundancy): 主風機必須有備用——如果潔淨室 HVAC 風機故障，將導致壓差喪失，可能危及產品品質和 BSL2 安全性。
blocks.en: Fan redundancy: The main fans must have backups. If a cleanroom HVAC fan fails, pressure differentials will be lost, which may endanger product quality and BSL2 safety.

blocks.zh: 為什麼活病毒處理區的排氣需要 H14 (99.995%) 而非 H13 (99.95%)？效率差異 0.045% 在實際意義上代表什麼？
blocks.en: Why does exhaust from live virus handling areas need H14 (99.995%) rather than H13 (99.95%)? What does the 0.045% difference in efficiency mean in practical terms?

blocks.zh: 「Full fresh air system」相比「回風系統」的主要缺點是什麼？在哪些情況下可以考慮部分回風？
blocks.en: What are the main disadvantages of a "full fresh air system" compared with a "recirculation system"? Under what circumstances could partial recirculation be considered?

blocks.zh: 8.4.4 Control and Automation System 8.4.4 管制與自動化系統
blocks.en: 8.4.4 Control and Automation System

blocks.zh: Stand-alone Control (獨立控制): 每台設備有自己的 PLC/PC 和 HMI，而非由中央系統統一控制。這在 SUS 設施中很常見，因為拋棄式設備供應商通常提供整合好的設備控制系統。
blocks.en: Stand-alone Control: Each piece of equipment has its own PLC/PC and HMI, rather than being controlled by a central system. This is common in SUS facilities because disposable equipment suppliers usually provide integrated equipment control systems.

blocks.zh: 三級使用者權限: 通常為 Operator（操作員）、Supervisor（主管）、Administrator（管理員），每級有不同的操作權限。這是 21 CFR Part 11 / EU GMP Annex 11 對電子記錄的基本要求。
blocks.en: Three-level user access: Usually Operator, Supervisor and Administrator, each with different operating permissions. This is a basic requirement of 21 CFR Part 11 / EU GMP Annex 11 for electronic records.

blocks.zh: Audit Trail (稽核追蹤): 系統必須記錄所有操作、修改、和數據存取的時間戳和操作者身份。這是數據完整性 (Data Integrity) 的核心要素。
blocks.en: Audit Trail: The system must record the time stamp and operator identity of all operations, modifications and data access. This is a core element of data integrity.

blocks.zh: FMS vs BMS: FMS 專注於 GMP 關鍵參數（潔淨室壓差、微粒、溫度等），BMS 負責整體建築的設施控制（照明、電力、一般 HVAC 等）。兩者通常是獨立系統，但可以交換數據。
blocks.en: FMS vs BMS: The FMS (facility monitoring system) focuses on GMP-critical parameters (cleanroom pressure differentials, particles, temperature, etc.), while the BMS (building management system) handles facility control of the building as a whole (lighting, power, general HVAC, etc.). The two are usually independent systems but can exchange data.

blocks.zh: 連續線上粒子監控: A 級和 B 級區域必須配備連續線上粒子監控——這是 EU GMP Annex 1 的要求。C 級區域使用多歧管系統 (Manifold System)，由一台粒子計數器輪流採樣多個採樣點，是一種成本效益較高的方案。
blocks.en: Continuous online particle monitoring: Grade A and B areas must be equipped with continuous online particle monitoring, as required by EU GMP Annex 1. Grade C areas use a manifold system, in which one particle counter samples multiple sampling points in turn, a cost-effective solution.

blocks.zh: URS 中指出「electronic records but no electronic batch records」——表示雖然有電子數據記錄，但批次記錄仍以紙本為主。這在 2014 年是常見做法，但現今趨勢已朝向電子批次記錄 (EBR) 發展。
blocks.en: The URS states "electronic records but no electronic batch records", meaning that although electronic data records exist, batch records are still mainly paper-based. This was common practice in 2014, but today the trend is toward electronic batch records (EBR).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 URS 要求設備控制系統具備與 SCADA 通訊的能力，即使目前不使用 SCADA？
blocks.en: Why does the URS require equipment control systems to be able to communicate with SCADA, even though SCADA is not currently used?

blocks.zh: 「Stand-alone」設備控制與「集中式」控制各有何優缺點？在 SUS 設施中為何偏好前者？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of "stand-alone" versus "centralized" equipment control? Why is the former preferred in SUS facilities?

blocks.zh: 8.4.5 Health, Safety, and Environmental Requirements 8.4.5 健康、安全與環境需求
blocks.en: 8.4.5 Health, Safety, and Environmental Requirements

blocks.zh: HSE (健康、安全、環境) 風險分析: 這是設施設計中與 GMP 同等重要但常被忽視的面向。URS 要求進行系統性的 HSE 風險評估，涵蓋：
blocks.en: HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) risk analysis: This is an aspect of facility design that is as important as GMP but often overlooked. The URS requires a systematic HSE risk assessment covering:

blocks.zh: 健康 (Health): 人員暴露於生物危害物質的風險
blocks.en: Health: risk of personnel exposure to biohazardous materials

blocks.zh: 安全 (Safety): 液態氮窒息風險、高壓蒸氣燙傷風險等
blocks.en: Safety: liquid nitrogen asphyxiation risk, high-pressure steam scald risk, etc.

blocks.zh: 環境 (Environment): 排氣過濾、廢水滅活、廢棄物分類處理
blocks.en: Environment: exhaust filtration, waste water inactivation, waste segregation and treatment

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處理優先順序: 再利用 → 能源回收 → 最後才是掩埋。這反映了歐盟的永續發展法規要求，對 SUS 設施尤為重要，因為拋棄式設備會產生大量塑膠廢棄物。
blocks.en: Waste handling priority: reuse → energy recovery → landfill only as a last resort. This reflects EU sustainable development regulatory requirements and is especially important for SUS facilities, because disposable equipment generates large amounts of plastic waste.

blocks.zh: 緊急系統的層次化設計:
blocks.en: Tiered design of emergency systems:

blocks.zh: UPS (不斷電系統): 提供短時間（通常 15-30 分鐘）的備用電力，讓關鍵設備（UDAF 罩、HVAC、監控系統）有序關機或切換到柴油發電機
blocks.en: UPS (uninterruptible power supply): provides short-term backup power (usually 15-30 minutes), allowing critical equipment (UDAF hoods, HVAC, monitoring systems) to shut down in an orderly way or switch to the diesel generator

blocks.zh: 柴油發電機: 提供長時間備用電力，覆蓋範圍更廣（包括冷凍櫃和冷藏庫）
blocks.en: Diesel generator: provides long-term backup power with wider coverage (including freezers and cold rooms)

blocks.zh: 兩者配合形成「無縫供電」：UPS 負責瞬間切換，柴油發電機負責長期供電
blocks.en: Together they form "seamless power supply": the UPS handles the instantaneous switchover, and the diesel generator handles long-term supply

blocks.zh: 注意：不需要灑水系統 (Sprinkler = No)——這可能是因為潔淨室中灑水會造成嚴重的微粒和微生物污染，以及 BSL2 區域的水可能被生物污染。替代方案可能是惰性氣體滅火系統。
blocks.en: Note: no sprinkler system is required (Sprinkler = No). This may be because sprinkler discharge in a cleanroom would cause severe particulate and microbial contamination, and water in BSL2 areas could become biologically contaminated. An inert gas fire suppression system may be the alternative.

blocks.zh: 緊急供電系統就像醫院的電力備援——手術室的電力不能中斷，即使外面停電了，UPS 立刻接手供電，同時柴油發電機在幾十秒內啟動提供長期電力。SUS 設施的 UDAF 罩和 HVAC 就像手術室的無影燈和層流系統——一旦斷電，無菌環境就會被破壞。
blocks.en: An emergency power system is like a hospital's power backup: power to the operating room cannot be interrupted, so even if the outside power fails, the UPS takes over immediately while the diesel generator starts within seconds to provide long-term power. The UDAF hoods and HVAC of an SUS facility are like the surgical lights and laminar flow system of an operating room: once power is lost, the sterile environment is compromised.

blocks.zh: SUS 設施產生的大量塑膠廢棄物如何與「永續發展」目標平衡？有哪些可行的解決方案？
blocks.en: How can the large amount of plastic waste generated by an SUS facility be balanced against "sustainable development" goals? What feasible solutions are there?

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要「氧氣感測器」？液態氮在什麼情況下會對人員造成危險？
blocks.en: Why is an "oxygen sensor" needed? Under what circumstances is liquid nitrogen dangerous to personnel?

blocks.zh: 如果潔淨室不使用灑水系統，應該採用什麼替代消防方案？
blocks.en: If a cleanroom does not use a sprinkler system, what alternative fire protection scheme should be adopted?

blocks.zh: 8.4.6 Maintenance and Service 8.4.6 維護與服務
blocks.en: 8.4.6 Maintenance and Service

blocks.zh: 預防性維護 (Preventive Maintenance): URS 要求在生產開始前就建立完整的維護計畫。每件設備都有唯一的項目編號 (Item Number)，確保可追溯性。系統能自動產生週報，提前通知需要維護的設備。
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance: The URS requires a complete maintenance plan to be established before production starts. Each piece of equipment has a unique Item Number to ensure traceability. The system can automatically generate weekly reports to give advance notice of equipment needing maintenance.

blocks.zh: 計畫性停機 (Planned Shutdown): 每年夏季和冬季各一次停機維護——選擇夏季和冬季可能是考慮到可以同時進行 HVAC 系統的季節性維護。
blocks.en: Planned Shutdown: One maintenance shutdown each summer and winter. Summer and winter were probably chosen so that seasonal maintenance of the HVAC system can be carried out at the same time.

blocks.zh: 備品策略: 儲存兩年份的備品——這對 SUS 設施尤其重要，因為一次性耗材的供應鏈中斷會直接影響生產。備品計畫必須涵蓋不僅是設備零件，還有拋棄式組件的安全庫存。
blocks.en: Spare parts strategy: Two years of spare parts are stored. This is especially important for SUS facilities, because a supply chain interruption for single-use consumables directly affects production. The spare parts plan must cover not only equipment parts but also safety stock of disposable components.

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 設施中，維護需求與傳統不鏽鋼設施有很大不同：不需要管路和容器的定期重新鈍化 (Re-passivation)、不需要墊片的定期更換、不需要焊接接頭的定期檢查——但需要確保搖擺裝置、蠕動泵驅動器等支撐設備的正常運作。
blocks.en: In an SUS facility, maintenance needs are very different from those of a traditional stainless steel facility: no periodic re-passivation of piping and vessels, no periodic replacement of gaskets, no periodic inspection of welded joints, but it must be ensured that supporting equipment such as rocking platforms and peristaltic pump drives operate properly.

blocks.zh: 8.5 Documentation Requirements / 8.6 Validation and Testing 8.5 文件需求 / 8.6 驗證與測試
blocks.en: 8.5 Documentation Requirements / 8.6 Validation and Testing

blocks.zh: 文件需求 (Documentation Requirements): URS 的最後幾節提醒我們，設施專案不僅僅是硬體和設備——文件體系同樣是 URS 的一部分。URS 應定義：
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements: The last sections of the URS remind us that a facility project is not only about hardware and equipment: the documentation system is also part of the URS. The URS should define:

blocks.zh: 版本管理 (Version Handling): 所有文件的版本控制規則
blocks.en: Version Handling: version control rules for all documents

blocks.zh: 風險評估 (Risk Assessment): 要求在設計階段進行哪些風險評估
blocks.en: Risk Assessment: which risk assessments are required at the design stage

blocks.zh: SOPs: 需要在生產前完成哪些標準作業程序
blocks.en: SOPs: which standard operating procedures must be completed before production

blocks.zh: 驗證與測試 (Validation & Testing): IQ/OQ/PQ 的基本策略和範圍
blocks.en: Validation & Testing: the basic strategy and scope of IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 這些「佔位符」式的章節提醒 URS 撰寫者：即使在初始版本中無法完全定義所有細節，也要在 URS 的結構中為這些主題保留位置。隨著專案推進，這些章節會被逐步充實。這體現了 URS 作為「活文件」的特性。
blocks.en: These "placeholder" sections remind URS authors that even if not all details can be fully defined in the initial version, a place must be reserved in the URS structure for these topics. As the project advances, these sections will be gradually filled in. This reflects the nature of the URS as a "living document".

blocks.zh: 為什麼驗證策略需要在 URS 階段就開始規劃，而不是等到設備安裝完成後？
blocks.en: Why does the validation strategy need to be planned at the URS stage, rather than waiting until equipment installation is complete?

blocks.zh: URS 中的風險評估要求與後續的 FMEA 或 HACCP 分析有何關係？
blocks.en: How does the risk assessment requirement in the URS relate to subsequent FMEA or HACCP analysis?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: URS 的定位: User Requirement Specification 是 SUS 設施專案的基礎文件，定義「需要什麼」而非「如何做到」，是後續所有設計和驗證活動的起點
blocks.en: Role of the URS: The User Requirement Specification is the foundation document of an SUS facility project. It defines "what is needed" rather than "how to achieve it" and is the starting point for all subsequent design and qualification/validation activities

blocks.zh: 範例場景: 本 URS 範例描述的是一個用於基因治療腺病毒載體生產的 BSL2 級 SUS 設施，需同時符合 EU GMP 和 FDA cGMP
blocks.en: Example scenario: This URS example describes a BSL2 SUS facility for the production of gene therapy adenovirus vectors, which must comply with both EU GMP and FDA cGMP

blocks.zh: SUS 對設施設計的影響: 免去 CIP/SIP 系統，但仍需高壓滅菌釜、WFI 系統、潔淨蒸氣等基礎公用設施；同時增加了拋棄式耗材的儲存需求
blocks.en: Impact of SUS on facility design: CIP/SIP systems are eliminated, but basic utilities such as the autoclave, WFI system and clean steam are still needed; storage requirements for disposable consumables increase

blocks.zh: BSL2 的設計挑戰: 需要全新風 HVAC 系統、排氣 HEPA H14 過濾、廢水/廢棄物滅活系統、以及 GMP 正壓與 BSL2 負壓之間的壓差平衡
blocks.en: BSL2 design challenges: A full fresh air HVAC system, H14 HEPA filtration of exhaust, waste water/waste inactivation systems, and balancing of pressure differentials between GMP positive pressure and BSL2 negative pressure

blocks.zh: 潔淨室分級: 從 Grade A (ISO 5) 到 Unclassified，每個功能區域都需要明確定義其潔淨等級，且需同時參照 ISO 14644 和 EU GMP 標準
blocks.en: Cleanroom classification: From Grade A (ISO 5) to Unclassified, the cleanliness grade of each functional area must be clearly defined, with reference to both ISO 14644 and EU GMP standards

blocks.zh: 控制與監控: 獨立設備控制 + SCADA 整合能力 + FMS/BMS 環境監控，構成完整的自動化架構
blocks.en: Control and monitoring: Stand-alone equipment control + SCADA integration capability + FMS/BMS environmental monitoring make up the complete automation architecture

blocks.zh: HSE 與緊急系統: UPS + 柴油發電機的分層供電保障、廢棄物分類與滅活處理、氧氣偵測器等安全措施是 BSL2 SUS 設施的必備要素
blocks.en: HSE and emergency systems: Tiered power supply with UPS + diesel generator, waste segregation and inactivation, and safety measures such as oxygen detectors are essential elements of a BSL2 SUS facility

blocks.zh: 活文件概念: URS 是隨專案演進持續更新的文件，初版可以有佔位符式的章節，後續逐步充實
blocks.en: Living document concept: The URS is continuously updated as the project evolves; the initial version may contain placeholder sections that are gradually filled in later
